title: Costs
lead: What driving electric costs you, compared with a combustion car.
estimateNote: All figures are estimates. The journey log records the energy a trip used, not what you paid. Costs follow from the prices of your charging places (or a fixed home share), a fixed charging loss and the prices below. The petrol comparison assumes the same distance in a car with the consumption shown.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.note: Change the three main prices here; everything below updates at once.
assumptions.derived: Home share {{share}}, blended price {{price}}/kWh, charging loss {{loss}}, grid mix {{co2}} g CO₂/kWh, petrol car {{consumption}} l/100 km.
assumptions.coverage: Only the {{count}} trips with an energy value are counted; the petrol car is compared over the same {{distance}}.
assumptions.co2Note: CO₂ counts petrol tailpipe emissions ({{factor}} kg per litre) and the grid mix for the electricity. Fuel production and manufacturing are not included.
assumptions.mixPlacesHint_one: Weighted by the energy of {{count}} detected charging session and the price of each place.
assumptions.mixPlacesHint_other: Weighted by the energy of {{count}} detected charging sessions and the price of each place.
